input: Hello everyone! I hope the new coffee machine is treating you well. Just so you know, the monthly team meeting is moving from Tuesday to Thursday this week, same time. Let me know if you have any questions. Best, Ravi

Hey team, thanks for all your hard work this quarter! Starting next month, parking in the main lot will cost $5 per day. The side street is still free. Have a lovely weekend! Jo
